body:
## Breaking changes
* Make /stop and /stats/reset POST-only. If you're using the web UI as an api, you'll need to adjust your calls https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3567

## What's Changed
* chore: move resonse -> response from geventhttpclient and set min geventhttpclient version to 2.5.1 by @even-even in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3540
* chore: up python 3.13 -> 3.14 in dockerfiles and up uv to 0.12.24 by @even-even in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3542
* Percent-encode the request target in FastHttpUser by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3541
* Cancel the web UI run_time timer when a test is stopped or restarted by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3543
* Keep OTEL request names that were already seen when the name cap is reached by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3544
* Accept response_time=None in the OTEL and CSV request listeners by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3545
* Report a malformed HTTP response in FastHttpUser as a failed request by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3549
* Do not report a duplicate shape class when one locustfile imports it from another by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3553
* Keep a fractional spawn rate in the --html report file name by @Lesereingrape in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3555
* Reject a non-finite spawn_rate instead of reporting a successful start by @Lesereingrape in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3557
* Fix RST warnings for **kwargs in Milvus/Qdrant user docstrings by @SatvikMishra08 in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3551
* Create the output directory for --html, --csv, --json-file and --logfile by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3550
* Do not ask users that are already stopping to stop again by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3548
* Use a local server instead of www.locust.io in two test_main tests by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3561
* Keep the worker's message loop alive when a custom message listener raises by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3552
* Do not crash locust_exception_handler when Environment.parsed_options is None by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3562
* Do not skip the next listener when a listener removes itself while the event fires by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3563
* Fire user_error when an exception is raised in User.on_start by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3564
* Fix MongoDBClient querying the wrong database and never running the query by @SulimanAbdulrazzaq in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3565
* Make /stop and /stats/reset POST-only to close CSRF vector by @charan-rathore in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3567
* fix: don't crash the stats history CSV writer on workers with --csv-full-history by @ybai08 in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3568
* test: use local_http_server instead of www.locust.io in test_pytest_locustfile by @piyusha2005-bit in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3569

## New Contributors
* @SatvikMishra08 made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3551
* @charan-rathore made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3567
* @ybai08 made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3568
* @piyusha2005-bit made their first contribution in https://github.com/locustio/locust/pull/3569

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/locustio/locust/compare/2.46.7...2.47.0
